heroLead: I support athletes, parents and coaches as they navigate pressure, motivation, confidence and the more difficult parts of life in sport.
heroNote: The first conversation is a chance to meet and clarify your goals.
areasTitle: When you need more than “pull yourself together”
areasLead: Some challenges in sport call for more than another training session. This is a place to talk through what feels difficult and consider the next step.
area1Desc: Managing expectations, mistakes and tension around competition.
area2Desc: Understanding your reactions and keeping your attention where it matters.
area3Desc: When training stops feeling rewarding and self-imposed pressure grows.
area4Desc: Working through difficult performances and adjusting after time away from sport.
aboutTitle: Behind every sporting goal is a person
aboutP1: My name is Full Name. This is where your personal story belongs: how you began working with athletes, what matters to you and how you approach your work.
aboutP2: Write in your own voice, without generic promises or unnecessary jargon. Visitors should get a real sense of the person they may be working with.
credential1Desc: Add verified qualifications, degrees and relevant training.
credential2Desc: Include relevant work, collaborations or talks — facts only.
processLead: It helps to know what to expect. The programme and frequency of meetings are agreed individually.
blogTitle: About sport and the people who live it
blogLead: Articles, reflections and practical insights for athletes, parents and coaches.
reviewsTitle: A few words about working together
reviewsLead: Written testimonials with a personal, handwritten feel — no screenshots or unnecessary client details.
contactTitle: Shall we start with a conversation?
contactLead: Let me know how you prefer to communicate. You do not need to share your whole personal story in the first message — a simple question is enough.
faq1A: You can share your preferred format when you get in touch. The availability of in-person sessions is confirmed individually.
faq2Q: How long is a session and what does it cost?
faq2A: Add the confirmed duration, prices and payment terms here before publishing. You can also ask for these details before booking.
faq3Q: Can I ask about support for my child?
faq3A: Arrangements for working with minors, parental involvement and any required consent should be clarified before sessions begin.
faq4A: Confidentiality rules, data handling and any exceptions should be explained before work begins, in line with professional and local requirements.
